pages.title: Dc Comics Joker Holding a Joker Playing Card in His Gloved Hand Coloring Page
pages.description: The Joker holds up a playing card in this printable coloring page, showing a jester design beside his wide grin, bow tie, and lapel flower. Stars and round bubbles surround the portrait, while the coloring sheet leaves broad sections in his jacket and smaller spaces in the card and teeth.

pages.title: Dc Comics Joker Spraying Water From His Lapel Flower While Batman Shields His Face Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Joker spraying water from his lapel flower as Batman raises an arm to shield his face from the splash. The Joker's long coat and striped trousers contrast with Batman's sweeping cape, and the coloring sheet uses large open shapes around the two standing figures.

pages.title: Dc Comics Joker Displaying the Circular Joy Buzzer Fastened to His Open Gloved Palm Coloring Page
pages.description: The Joker displays a circular joy buzzer on his open glove in this printable coloring page, leaning forward with a toothy grin and swept-back hair. A coiled wire hangs below the strapped device, and the coloring sheet includes a large bow tie, lapel flower, and open jacket panels.

pages.title: Dc Comics Joker Firing a Toy Pistol That Unfurls a Bang Flag Coloring Page
pages.description: A flag reading BANG unfurls from the Joker's toy pistol in this printable coloring page, with his broad grin and oversized bow tie prominently visible. Small motion marks surround the barrel, while the coloring sheet keeps the background blank and separates the jacket, glove, flag, and swept hair into clear sections.

pages.title: Joker and Harley Quinn in Her Jester Costume Outside an Abandoned Funhouse Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places the Joker and Harley Quinn outside an abandoned funhouse, with her jester hood and diamond-patterned costume in the foreground. A cracked clown-face entrance, boarded windows, loose planks, and torn bunting fill the coloring sheet behind the pair, adding smaller details around their larger costume shapes.

pages.title: The Joker's Grinning Face with Swept-back Hair, Arched Eyebrows and a Large Bow Tie Coloring Page
pages.description: The Joker's grinning face fills this printable coloring page, framed by swept-back hair, sharply arched eyebrows, pointed jacket lapels, and a large bow tie. The close-up coloring sheet has an uncluttered background, with broad hair sections and bow loops surrounding the smaller outlines of his eyes, teeth, and facial creases.

pages.title: Joker Confronting Batman on a Gotham Rooftop Beneath the Bat-signal Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Joker confronting Batman on a Gotham rooftop beneath the Bat-Signal, with tall buildings stretching behind their full-length figures. The Joker gestures with both hands as Batman stands with clenched fists; brickwork, roof vents, and costume details add smaller areas to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Joker Planning a Gotham City Heist with the Penguin and the Riddler Around a Map Coloring Page
pages.description: The Joker plans a Gotham heist with the Penguin and the Riddler in this printable coloring page, gathered over a folded street map marked with an X. The coloring sheet distinguishes the trio through a lapel flower, tall top hat, and question-mark suit, with a hanging bulb above the table.

pages.title: Chibi Joker Opening a Jack-in-the-box with a Spring-mounted Clown Inside Coloring Page
pages.description: A chibi Joker opens a jack-in-the-box in this printable coloring page, watching a smiling clown spring upward in a striped party hat and ruffled collar. The tall coil, open lid, side crank, and star-shaped accents give this coloring sheet clear shapes around the character's large head and bow tie.

pages.title: Joker and Harley Quinn Walking Their Pet Hyenas Bud and Lou on Leashes Through Their Hideout Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows the Joker and Harley Quinn walking Bud and Lou on leashes through their hideout, with both spotted hyenas in front. Crates, jack-in-the-box toys, a circus drum, and patterned bunting surround the figures, giving the coloring sheet a mix of open clothing shapes and small decorative details.

pages.title: Joker Peering Through the Bars of His Arkham Asylum Cell Coloring Page
pages.description: The Joker peers through his Arkham Asylum cell bars in this printable coloring page, gripping two vertical rails while showing his wide grin and swept hair. The close portrait fills the coloring sheet, with small brick outlines at the sides and larger unpatterned sections in his shirt and jacket.

pages.title: Batman the Animated Series Joker Hosting His Christmas Television Show Beside a Studio Camera Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Animated Series Joker hosting a Christmas television show, holding a microphone beside a studio camera decorated with holly and garlands. His Santa hat, the ornamented tree, wrapped gifts, and overhead lights make this coloring sheet a detailed holiday studio scene.

pages.title: Batman the Animated Series Joker Escaping Arkham on a Rocket-powered Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: The Animated Series Joker escapes Arkham on a rocket-powered Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, waving from its decorated branches above billowing exhaust clouds. Ropes secure rockets to the tree, while baubles, garlands, a star topper, and the distant asylum gates add varied shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batman the Animated Series Joker Presenting a Grinning Fish at the Copyright Office Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Animated Series Joker presenting a grinning fish at the copyright office, leaning toward a startled clerk behind a crowded desk. Stacked papers, rubber stamps, a filing cabinet, and a copyright emblem fill the coloring sheet around the fish's oversized teeth and Joker's long coat.

pages.title: Batman the Animated Series Joker Standing Beside Captain Clown on a Garbage Barge Coloring Page
